optimality_status.evidence: Mertens and Bessenrodt report exhaustive search through N<=40 for the N=4t case; for N=64 Table 4 gives a numerical-search configuration with E=224 and a '?' ground-state status. No later proof closing this fixed periodic N=64 objective was found in the source check on 2026-11-06.
optimality_status.claim_limit: This is an open-status report based on checked sources; it is not an exhaustive literature survey.

independent_quantity.method: Cyclic bit rotation and XOR Hamming weights; independently verifies sum of all cyclic correlations equals squared sign sum.
